claims.notes:
Tracks the claim that Triton 3.6 contains Blackwell TMEM, tcgen05,
warp-specialization, scaled-MMA, and initial multi-CTA infrastructure.
The official release notes establish compiler capability. Retained
downstream anchors pr-vllm-34597 and pr-sglang-22079 demonstrate real
tl.dot kernels on SM100 paths; pr-sglang-21019 demonstrates an SM100
Triton memory-rearrangement kernel but not MMA lowering. These sources
do not prove a particular instruction form or performance for every
tl.dot shape. The 3.7.0 and 3.7.1 release records were checked on
2026-08-18 for continuity; the capability provenance remains the 3.6
release where these features were introduced.
